questions.stem: A 25-year-old man arrives at the emergency department after undergoing the physical fitness test for army job. He had to lift a 50 kg bag, run up a flight of stairs while carrying it, and proceed across a balance beam. He then had to do 50 pushups and 50 sit-ups. At the end, he developed dark urine and diffuse muscle pain. On examination BP: 112/70 mm Hg; P: 108 beats/minute; Temperature: 98°F; weak, tired, and in pain. Heart, Lung, Abdomen: normal, Reports: ECG: peaked T waves, potassium 6.8 mEq/dL; BUN 26 g/dL; creatinine 1.5 mg/dL, urine dipstick + blood, Calcium level: 6.8 mg/dL (low) Phosphate:7.0 mg/dl(elevated).What will be the immediate next step in the management
